steps.name: C-pure-import-and-interface-signatures
argv: import importlib,inspect,json; names=('sequence','railroad','zenuml','info'); modules=[importlib.import_module('py_mermaid.diagrams.'+name) for name in names]; rows=[{'module':m.__name__,'parse':str(inspect.signature(m.parse)),'build':str(inspect.signature(m.build)),'asyncBuild':inspect.iscoroutinefunction(m.build)} for m in modules]; assert all(r['asyncBuild'] for r in rows); from py_mermaid.rendering.skia.scene import Painter; print(json.dumps({'providers':rows,'Painter.measure':str(inspect.signature(Painter.measure)),'Painter.text':str(inspect.signature(Painter.text)),'Painter.style':str(inspect.signature(Painter.style)),'Painter.asset':str(inspect.signature(Painter.asset)),'nativeObjectsCreated':False},indent=2))
